source.title: Six Reasons Why the United States Is Low on Munitions

summary: CSIS says about half the initial inventory of Patriot, THAAD and PrSM has been used, and about a third of JASSM, Standard Missiles and Tomahawk. It argues enough remains for Iran, and the risk is a future war with China.
